description: Hand-written, labeled evaluation corpus. label 1 = contains a prompt-injection attempt; label 0 = benign (including text that only mentions/quotes an attack phrase). split 'dev' examples were visible while the rules were written; 'heldout' examples were written before the first evaluation run and were NOT used to tune rules. Both splits were written by the same author as the rules, so even 'heldout' is not an independent benchmark.
